label: Pixal3D
description: Pixal3D image-to-3D: same pipeline as TRELLIS.2 with the Pixal3D model, which is also conditioned on the photo's horizontal field of view (estimated with MoGe-2). Graph from ComfyUI's official 3d_pixal3d_trellis2_image_to_model template with the Pixal3D switch on. Requires pixal3d_int8_convrot + moge_2_vitl_normal + the TRELLIS.2 VAEs + dino_v3_L_naf + birefnet. Optional custom param: seed.

image.error: Pixal3D needs an upstream image — wire one into this stage's images slot.
